curves_note: The lab kept no step-by-step loss log except the raw trainer lines of the calibration run: 1 checkpoint publishes logged loss points (its first steps and its last step). For the others, v0 publishes the loss each trainer reported at the end of the run, when it was recorded; no full loss curve exists for them.
description: Local fine-tuning ('forge') runs on the rig, one record per checkpoint in data/forge/checkpoints/: recipe, training figures and aggregate scores. No training corpus, adapter, checkpoint weight, item or answer is released.

method.note: each run trained on a single RTX 3090 FE

variants.label: DPO preference tuning on top of a QLoRA fine-tune (TRL)

not_published: training corpora and datasets, and their names

score_definitions.abstention: questions whose source document was withdrawn where the model correctly declined (base: before fine-tuning)
score_definitions.knowledge: knowledge questions judged correct against a reference, after fine-tuning (base: the same base model before it)
score_definitions.no_fabrication: missing-document method questions answered without fabricating content
score_definitions.over_refusal: answerable questions the model wrongly declined (lower is better)
score_definitions.repetition_loops: answers that fell into a repetition loop (lower is better)
score_definitions.sentinels: sentinel questions answered in the expected form (base: the previous round)
score_definitions.useful_method: missing-document method questions where the described method was useful
